title: Abduction
description: While seated in the machine, spread your legs outward, squeeze your outer hip muscles, and return them in a controlled manner.

title: Adduction
description: While seated in the machine, bring your legs inward, squeeze your inner thigh muscles, and return to the starting position in a controlled manner.

title: Abs Leg Raises
description: Lie on your back, lift your legs until they are vertical, and slowly lower them using your lower abdominal muscles.

title: Crunch
description: Lie on your back with your knees bent, curl your torso up by contracting your abdominal muscles, then lower back down in a controlled manner.

title: Seated Cable Row
description: Sit with your chest upright and pull the handles toward your midsection, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

title: Lat Pulldown
description: Sit and grip the bar wide, pull it down until it's below your chin, and finish the movement by squeezing your lats.

title: Back Row
description: Sit with an upright posture, pull the bar toward your midsection by squeezing your shoulder blades, and lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Cable Shoulder Lateral Raises
description: Hold the cable to your side and, with your elbow bent, raise your arm to shoulder level.

title: Cable Crunch 1
description: Bend your knees, hold the cable behind your head, crunch your abs, and pull your torso downward.

title: Cable Crunch 2
description: Kneel, hold the cable above your head, and bend forward using your abdominal muscles.

title: Cable Overhead Extension
description: Grasp the cable overhead and extend your arms forward and upward, squeezing your triceps.

title: Cable Side Bends
description: Hold the cable with one hand steady and bend your torso to the side, tightening your obliques.

title: Calf Raises
description: Stand on your toes, lift your heels up, and lower them by contracting your calf muscles.

title: Face Pulls
description: Grip the cable at face level, pull your elbows back, and squeeze your rear deltoids.

title: Hyperextension
description: Position yourself on the hyperextension bench, keep your back straight, lift your torso upward, then lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Leg Extension
description: Sit, place the pad on your ankles, extend your knees, and squeeze your quads.

title: Leg Press
description: Place your feet on the platform, push the weight by straightening your knees from a bent position, and lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Lying Leg Curl
description: Lie face down, pull your heels toward the machine pad, and contract your hamstrings.

title: Preacher Curl
description: Place your arm on the pad, curl your wrist toward your shoulder by bending at the elbow, and squeeze your biceps.

title: Chest Butterfly
description: Sit in the machine, open your arms to the sides, squeeze your chest muscles, and return to the starting position.

title: Rear Delt Fly
description: Lean forward, open your arms out to the sides, squeeze your rear delts, and return to start.

title: Reverse Grip Triceps
description: Grip the cable with a reverse grip, keep your elbows stationary, and pull the arm downward.

title: Rotator Cuff
description: Sitting sideways or standing, keep your elbow against your body and externally rotate your forearm.

title: Seated Leg Curl
description: Sit, place the pad on your heels, bend your knees, and contract your hamstrings.

title: Smith Good Mornings
description: Position the bar on your shoulders in the Smith machine, hinge forward at the hips, then return upright.

title: Smith Squat
description: Set the bar at shoulder height on the Smith machine, squat down to work your quads and glutes.

title: Shoulder Press (Smith)
description: Seated in the Smith machine, press the bar upward from shoulder level and lower it.

title: Titled Lateral Raises
description: On an inclined bench, raise your arms out to the sides, working your deltoids.

title: Triceps Pushdown
description: Stand, push the cable handles downward with your elbows fixed, and contract your triceps.

title: Triceps Pushdown Rope
description: Hold the rope attachment with both hands, pull down with your elbows fixed, then flare your elbows and squeeze at the end.

title: Cable Biceps Curl
description: Stand, hold the cable with palms facing up, curl at the elbow, and squeeze your biceps.

title: Side Hip Abduction
description: Sitting on your side, lift your leg outward, squeeze your outer hip muscles, and lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Leg Raises 2
description: Hang from the bar and lift your legs forward, engaging your lower abs.

title: Leg Raises 3
description: Hang from the bar and bend your knees to engage your abs.

title: Twisted Hyperextension Abs
description: On the hyperextension bench, twist to one side, squeeze your obliques, and return to the starting position.

title: Alternate Leg Raises
description: Lie on your back, lift one leg straight up, contract your abdominal muscles, and lower it in a controlled manner.

title: Alternating Dumbbell Front Raise
description: Stand and alternately lift each dumbbell to shoulder height in front of you, then lower in a controlled manner.

title: Arm Blaster Hammer Curl
description: Lean against the arm blaster, lift the dumbbell with a hammer grip, and squeeze your biceps.

title: Arnold Press
description: While seated, press the dumbbells upward with your palms facing you, then rotate and squeeze your shoulders.

title: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: Rest your upper back on a bench, place the barbell on your hips, and thrust your hips upward.

title: Barbell Pin Squat
description: Place the barbell on the pins, squat down, and work your quadriceps and glutes.

title: Barbell Rear Delt Raise
description: Bend forward, hold the barbell with an overhand grip, raise it to the sides, and squeeze your rear delts.

title: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Rest your forearms on a bench, palms facing down, and curl your wrists upward.

title: Barbell Standing Military Press
description: Stand holding the barbell at shoulder height, press it overhead, and squeeze your shoulders.

title: Barbell Triceps Extension
description: Lying down, lower the barbell behind your head and press it up, squeezing your triceps.

title: Bench Side Bend
description: Lean sideways over the edge of a bench, contract your obliques, and return to the starting position.

title: Bent Over Reverse Cable Fly
description: Bend forward, hold the cable handles with an overhand grip, and open your arms to the sides to work your rear delts.

title: Cable Front Squat
description: Hold the cable handle at chest height and perform a squat.

title: Cable Reverse Grip EZ-bar Biceps Curl
alt: Cable Reverse Grip EZ-bar Biceps Curl
description: Grip the EZ-bar with a reverse grip, keep your elbows steady, and curl to work your biceps.

title: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
description: Hold the cable rope overhead and extend your arms upward to work your triceps.

title: Cable Side Triceps Extension
description: Hold the cable with one hand, keep your elbow steady, and extend your arm to work your triceps.

title: Cable Squat
description: Hold the cable in front of you, perform a squat, and work your quadriceps.

title: Cable Upper Chest Crossovers
description: Hold the cables from above, cross them in front of you, and squeeze your chest.

title: Chest Dips
description: Hold onto parallel bars, lean your torso forward, and perform dips to work your chest.

title: Close Grip Dumbbell Press
description: Lie on a bench, hold the dumbbells close together at your chest, and press upward.

title: Close Grip Z-Bar Curl
description: Grip the Z-bar with a narrow grip and curl to work your biceps.

title: Concentration Curl
description: Sit down, brace your elbow against your inner thigh, and curl the dumbbell.

title: Cross Crunch
description: Lie on the floor and touch your elbow to the opposite knee to work your obliques.

title: Decline Chest Press Machine
description: Adjust the decline bench and perform a pressing motion on the machine.

title: Double Arm Dumbbell Curl
description: Stand and curl two dumbbells with palms facing forward, then lower them.

title: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
description: With your back foot on a bench, squat down with your front leg.

title: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
description: Hold a dumbbell in front of your chest and perform a squat.

title: EZ-Bar Lying Close Grip Triceps Extension Behind Head
alt: EZ-Bar Close Grip Triceps Extension Behind Head
description: Lying on a bench, lower the EZ-bar behind your head and press it up to work your triceps.

title: Face Pull
description: Hold the cable at face level and pull your elbows back to work your rear delts.

title: Half Kneeling High Cable Row Rope
alt: Half Kneeling High Cable Row Rope
description: Kneel on one knee and pull the cable toward you to work your back.

title: Hanging Knee Raises
description: Hang from a bar and pull your knees up to your chest.

title: Incline Push Up
description: With your hands on an elevated surface, perform push-ups to work your chest.

title: Kneeling Push-up
description: With your knees on the ground, perform push-ups to work your upper body.

title: Leg Raise Dragon Flag
description: Lie on a bench, keep your body straight, and lift your legs upward.

title: Lever Shoulder Press
description: On the machine, press the lever arms upward to work your shoulders.

title: Lever Side Hip Abduction
description: On the machine, lift your leg to the side to work your outer glutes.

title: Lever Standing Leg Raise
description: On the machine, lift your leg forward to work your abs.

title: Low Cable Crossover
description: Hold the cables from below, cross them in front of you, and squeeze your chest.

title: Lying Leg Raise
description: Lie on your back and lift your legs straight up and down.

title: One Arm Lying Triceps Extension
description: Lying on a bench, extend a dumbbell overhead with one arm to work your triceps.

title: Overhead Cable Curl
description: Hold the cable overhead with palms up and curl to work your biceps.

title: Plank
description: Hold your body straight, supported on your elbows and toes, to engage your core.

title: Reverse Grip Pushdown
description: Grip the cable with a reverse grip and push down to work your triceps.

title: Seated Bench Leg Pull-in
description: Sit on a bench and pull your knees toward your chest to work your lower abs.

title: Seated Zottman Curl
description: Sit, curl the dumbbells with palms up, rotate at the top, and lower with palms down.

title: Sled Hack Squat
description: On the hack squat sled, perform a squat to work your quadriceps.

title: Smith Machine Hex Press
description: On the Smith machine, perform a bench press with a hex bar.

title: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
description: On the Smith machine, perform a bench press at an incline angle.

title: Smith Machine Leg Press
description: On the Smith machine, press the platform to work your leg muscles.

title: Smith Machine Squat
description: On the Smith machine, hold the bar at shoulder height and perform a squat.

title: Standing Barbell Close Grip Military Press
alt: Standing Barbell Close Grip Military Press
description: Stand and press the barbell overhead with a close grip from shoulder height.

title: Teaser Pilates
description: On a Pilates mat, hold a V position to contract your abdominal muscles.

title: Triceps Dips
description: On parallel bars, bend your arms to lower your body and work your triceps.

title: Triceps Dips on Floor
description: Sit on the floor, lift your body with your hands, and work your triceps.

title: Tuck Crunch
description: Lie on your back, pull your knees toward your chest, and contract your abs.

title: Two Arm Cable Front Raise
description: Hold the cable with both hands, palms down, and raise it in front of you.

title: Waiter Curl
description: Hold the dumbbell overhead and perform a curl to work your shoulders and biceps.

title: Weighted Crunch
description: Place a weight on your chest and perform a crunch.

title: Weighted Front Raise
description: Lift the dumbbells in front of you to work your front shoulder muscles.

title: Z-Bar Preacher Curl
description: Lean against the preacher bench and perform a curl with the Z-bar.
